description: Renovate owns version updates for Go, npm, Node.js, golangci-lint, GoReleaser, Naabu, Alpine packages, Dockerfiles, Docker images, and GitHub Actions. GitHub security alerts remain enabled separately.

customManagers.description: Update the golangci-lint release pin used by Makefile security checks.
Update the Naabu release that the image builds together with the commit its tag resolves to, which scripts/verify-naabu-pin.sh and the Dockerfile check.
Update the x/net version the pinned Naabu build overrides for the scanner image.
Update the Goldmark version the pinned Naabu build overrides to a fixed release.
Update the klauspost/compress version the pinned Naabu build overrides to a fixed release.
Update the digest-pinned images that workflow steps and scripts start: the QEMU binfmt installer, BuildKit, the BuildKit SBOM generator, and Grype.
Update the workflow NODE_VERSION variables and the maintainer guide's Node pin. The built-in github-actions manager owns the setup-node node-version inputs, and the nodenv manager owns .node-version.
Update the minimum Go version in the development guide together with go.mod.
matchStrings: The project uses Go (?<currentValue>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+) or newer

packageRules.description: Renovate leaves the go directive alone by default. Bump it with each Go release: CI and the release build with the Go version that go.mod names.
Update the go directive, the development guide's minimum Go version, and the golang images that build the image in one pull request. The workflow test requires them to name the same Go release.

Keep the container, workflow, version-file, and guide Node pins together on one supported Node 24 release. Match the dependency name, because the github-actions manager looks setup-node versions up as the package actions/node-versions. Accept a leading v, because the node-version datasource lists releases as v24.x.y.

Wait three days before proposing an npm release: the registry lets its author unpublish it within 72 hours, and most malicious releases are found and removed in that time. Security updates are not delayed.
binfmt tags name the QEMU version, such as qemu-v10.2.3.
